summary.headline: Venus and Marriage in Nativities
summary.text: Astrological judgments on Venus in nativities: its condition, sign, house, and aspects indicate the quality and stability of marriage, multiple or same-sex partners, sexual preference, and the death of women or men. Particular configurations involving Mars, Saturn, Mercury, the Moon, Cancer, and Capricorn are specified.
